title: Speedy Maths
summary: A “Speedy Maths” session was conducted by Rotaract Shreyas, RCKCM for the Interactors of Matunga Premier School on 10th October, 2026.
description:
A “Speedy Maths” session was conducted by Rotaract Shreyas, RCKCM for the Interactors of Matunga
Premier School on 10th October, 2026. The session was attended by sixteen 9
th
standards Interactors.
The session combined techniques from Vedic Maths and Mental Maths, introducing students to
simple and effective methods for solving numerical problems quickly. Using the number line and
other easy techniques, the students learned how to perform multi-digit addition, subtraction and
multiplication in a fraction of the usual time.
The Interactors participated with great enthusiasm and showed remarkable interest throughout the
session. Overall, the session was highly engaging, informative and educative, demonstrating how
mathematics can be made faster, simpler and more enjoyable.
location: Matunga Premier School, Matunga, Mumbai, Maharashtra
